text: Steenbarger asks if the ADVANCE trigger carries a volume test. It does not: h1_close_above:bar_high fires on any volume, and day_vol 0.24 is a quarter of normal, the clearest R4 fail in the room (C16). I hold OPPOSE. What clears it: the trigger reads h1_close_above:bar_high on volume at least 1.4x normal (day_vol 1.40). Without that clause the ACT_NOW count buys a move nobody bought. Market gate DELEGATED (C1); C/A/S/I untested.
